question: What’s the closest restaurant along the route from Eddie C. Moore Park, Clearwater, FL to Crowley Museum and Nature Center, Old Myakka, FL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.710231 27.969393)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.260576 27.310796)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.710231 27.969393)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.710231 27.969393)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Eddie C. Moore Park, Clearwater, FL

[3].display_name: Crowley Museum and Nature Center, Old Myakka, FL
